categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise engaged in research, development, production and sales of high-density printed circuit boards (PCB). It provides a comprehensive range of PCB products including double-layer boards, multi-layer boards, HDI (High Density Interconnect) boards, thick copper boards, high-frequency/high-speed boards, metal substrate boards, ceramic substrate boards, IC substrate boards, and flexible-rigid composite boards. Products are primarily applied in automotive electronics, new energy, network communications, consumer electronics, industrial control, medical devices, and smart terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including ultra-thick board processing with high-speed signal transmission, high-frequency mixed-pressure technology, 16-layer arbitrary-layer interconnect technology, 30-45μm ultra-thin PP lamination technology, laser blind hole technology (75±10μm), and precision line width/spacing technology (50/50μm). Production utilizes an integrated digital manufacturing system combining ERP, PDM, MES, QMS, WMS, EM, and EAP systems for full-process digitalization and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive electronics suppliers (BYD, Aptiv, BCS, Lear, Joyson), high-end HDI customers (Yidao Information, Huaqin Technology, Tongli Technology, DJI, Kuangmu Technology, Luxshare Precision, Wentai Technology, Mabowell, Yingka Technology), new energy companies (Sungrow Power, Ginlong Technologies, Yingyuan, Youyou Green Energy, ZTE, Shouhang New Energy), and communications equipment manufacturers (Ruijie Networks, Kuaijie, ZTE, Haoyang Tianyu). Applications span automotive electronics, new energy systems, network communications, consumer electronics, industrial control, and medical devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with production bases in Guangdong Province (Daya Bay), Jiangxi Province (Ganzhou, Jiujiang, Shangrao), and has a subsidiary in Hong Kong. Major manufacturing facilities are located in Huizhou Daya Bay, Ganzhou, Jiujiang, and Shangrao in Jiangxi Province. The company also maintains international sales channels with overseas business primarily in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the electronics supply chain, functioning as a PCB manufacturer and supplier. It sources raw materials (copper-clad laminates, copper foil, copper balls, semi-cured sheets) from upstream suppliers and supplies finished PCB products to downstream customers in electronics assembly and device manufacturing industries. The company also engages in some downstream activities through subsidiaries in semiconductor packaging and battery technology.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing high-end PCB technology in AI servers, automotive electronics, and new energy applications; (2) developing ultra-precision manufacturing capabilities (35/35μm line width/spacing, 75μm laser blind holes); (3) expanding product portfolio in high-frequency/high-speed boards, ceramic substrates, and flexible-rigid composites; (4) implementing intelligent manufacturing through AI-driven decision systems and industrial IoT platforms; (5) pursuing strategic partnerships with research institutions for collaborative innovation in PCB manufacturing processes and materials.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of PCB products to customers in automotive electronics, new energy, communications, and consumer electronics sectors. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also generates revenue from contract manufacturing services (semi-process outsourcing) and material sales. In 2024, PCB manufacturing accounted for 91.55% of revenue, with other business revenue (material sales) comprising 8.45%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks 29th among China's top 100 PCB manufacturers and 15th among domestic PCB enterprises according to the China Electronics Circuit Industry Association's 2023 rankings. Globally, it ranks 51st among the top 100 PCB companies per the 2023 NTI-100 rankings. The company competes through technological differentiation in high-end PCB segments, particularly in HDI, high-frequency/high-speed boards, and automotive electronics applications, positioning itself as a technology-driven manufacturer rather than a cost-based competitor.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 3.396 billion yuan, representing 14.63% growth compared to 2.962 billion yuan in 2023. However, the company reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of 343.66 million yuan in 2024 (compared to 159.31 million yuan loss in 2023), primarily due to underutilized capacity at newly established production bases in Jiangxi Province and compressed profit margins from industry competition and elevated raw material costs. Total assets reached 7.351 billion yuan at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive one-stop PCB product portfolio addressing diverse customer needs from basic multi-layer boards to advanced HDI and specialty boards; (2) advanced manufacturing capabilities in ultra-precision processing, high-frequency technology, and ceramic substrates; (3) specialized production base strategy with each facility optimized for specific product types and customer segments; (4) strong customer relationships with leading global brands requiring stringent supplier qualification; (5) intelligent manufacturing systems enabling rapid customization and quality assurance; (6) technical expertise in emerging applications including AI servers, automotive ADAS systems, and new energy storage solutions.
